# JSONPath

Query JSON with JSONPath expressions ($.store.book[?(@.price < 10)].title).

Category: Testers · ID: `jsonpath` · Search terms: json, path, query, jq, filter, select

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui jsonpath [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. JSON

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--path` | text | `$` | Path. JSONPath expression; $ is the root |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/jsonpath`), so they are what the tool prints.

### store-all-prices

Input:

```text
{
  "store": {
    "book": [
      {"category": "reference", "author": "Nigel Rees", "title": "Sayings of the Century", "price": 8.95},
      {"category": "fiction", "author": "Evelyn Waugh", "title": "Sword of Honour", "price": 12.99},
      {"category": "fiction", "author": "Herman Melville", "title": "Moby Dick", "isbn": "0-553-21311-3", "price": 8.99},
      {"category": "fiction", "author": "J. R. R. Tolkien", "title": "The Lord of the Rings", "isbn": "0-395-19395-8", "price": 22.99}
    ],
    "bicycle": {"color": "red", "price": 19.95}
  },
  "expensive": 10
}
```

Output:

```text
[
  8.95,
  12.99,
  8.99,
  22.99,
  19.95
]
```
